blockers.wanted: a single glass modal with clearly inharmonic partials in 1.5-6 kHz
blockers.tried: plate and shell with f0 1500-1800 and f_max 6200: partials land near 1 : 2 : 2.4 : 3 : 4 (shell) or only a close pair at 2.5x (plate); inharmonicity read 184-293 cents on 2-3 partials only
blockers.workaround: mixed a bar modal (f0 1650) and a plate modal (f0 2300) on the same contact; final inharmonicity 48 cents, partials 1.81k 2.54k 5.0k

blockers.wanted: a trustworthy aliasing reading for a sum of inharmonic sines
blockers.tried: read listen: aliasing -12.7 dB for a modal sum with nothing above 6 kHz (probably counts inharmonic partials as off-grid); YIN pitch reads an octave low (569-881 Hz) on a sound whose strongest mode is 1.65-1.8 kHz
blockers.workaround: ignored both, used the modes line and the spectrogram

blockers.wanted: name a mix the same as a node being replaced
blockers.tried: upsert a mix named body over a modal named body: 'delete it first or pick another name'
blockers.workaround: put a delete op for body and used a new name; clear message, cost one call

wishlist: a modal option to detune or scale the mode table (a stretch like spectral stretch) for more inharmonic single objects
a pitch claim for macros so a pitch/size knob can be held to its name
what_worked: contact -> modal glass with f0 and f_max placed modes where the brief asked at once
loss as a macro target gave a clean decay claim 0.06 to 0.70 s, passed verify
modes line in listen showed partial Hz and decay times directly
